description: This file appears to be a minified or concatenated JavaScript library related to Material Design for Bootstrap (MDB). It includes code for easing functions, velocity animations, chart rendering, and color conversions. The comments indicate it is part of MDB's static JavaScript bundle, with dependencies on libraries like Chart.js and color conversion utilities.

classes.name: Color
classes.description: A class for parsing and manipulating colors in various formats, providing methods for converting between color spaces, adjusting color properties, and outputting string representations.

classes.name: Chart.DatasetController
classes.description: Base class for all dataset controllers handling data updates, element creation, drawing, and interaction for various chart types.

classes.name: Chart.Element
classes.description: Base class for visual elements in charts, handling properties, transitions, and rendering.

classes.name: Chart.Animation
classes.description: Class managing animations for chart updates, including progress callbacks and easing functions.

classes.name: LinearScale
classes.description: A linear scale for chart axes, capable of handling numeric data, generating ticks, and converting between pixel and data values.

classes.name: LogarithmicScale
classes.description: A logarithmic scale for chart axes, supporting dynamic tick generation on logarithmic data ranges.

classes.name: TimeScale
classes.description: A time-based scale that handles date/time data, generating appropriately spaced ticks, and converting timestamps to pixel positions.

classes.name: LinearRadialScale
classes.description: A radial scale for polar or radar charts, supporting circular tick lines, point labels, and radius calculations.

methods.name: getRgba
methods.description: Parses a color string and returns an RGBA array.

methods.name: hexString
methods.description: Converts RGB array to hex color string.

methods.name: rgbString
methods.description: Returns an 'rgb()' or 'rgba()' string for given RGBA array.

methods.name: keyword
methods.description: Returns the color keyword name for an RGB array.

methods.name: listenArrayEvents
methods.description: Wraps array methods ('push', 'pop', 'shift', 'splice', 'unshift') to notify listeners after modifications.

methods.name: unlistenArrayEvents
methods.description: Removes array event listeners and cleans up wrappers.

methods.name: configMerge
methods.description: Deeply merges multiple configuration objects with custom merging for scales and other chart-specific configs.

methods.name: scaleMerge
methods.description: Merges scale-related configuration objects, especially handling xAxes and yAxes arrays.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Filters a collection based on a callback predicate, similar to Array.prototype.filter.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Finds index of an element in an array that satisfies a callback predicate.

methods.name: findNextWhere
methods.description: Finds the next item in an array after a starting index that matches a predicate.

methods.name: findPreviousWhere
methods.description: Finds the previous item in an array before a starting index that matches a predicate.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a value is a finite number.

methods.name: almostEquals
methods.description: Checks if two numbers are approximately equal within a given epsilon.

methods.name: almostWhole
methods.description: Checks if a number is close to its rounded integer value.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value in an array, ignoring non-numeric values.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value in an array, ignoring non-numeric values.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Returns the sign of a number, with fallback for environments without Math.sign.

methods.name: log10
methods.description: Calculates logarithm base 10, with fallback if Math.log10 is unavailable.

methods.name: getAngleFromPoint
methods.description: Calculates the angle and distance from a center point to a target point.

methods.name: distanceBetweenPoints
methods.description: Calculates Euclidean distance between two points.

methods.name: aliasPixel
methods.description: Utility for aligning pixel boundaries for crisp drawing.

methods.name: splineCurve
methods.description: Calculates control points for smooth spline curves between points, respecting skipped points.

methods.name: nextItem
methods.description: Returns the next item in a collection, with optional looping.

methods.name: previousItem
methods.description: Returns the previous item in a collection, with optional looping.

methods.name: niceNum
methods.description: Calculates a 'nice' number for axis labels or tick marks.

methods.name: requestAnimFrame
methods.description: Polyfill for window.requestAnimationFrame with fallback to setTimeout.

methods.name: getPixelForTick
methods.description: Calculates the pixel position on the scale axis for a specific tick index, considering scale padding and offsets.

methods.name: getPixelForDecimal
methods.description: Returns the pixel position corresponding to a decimal percentage of the scale length, horizontally or vertically.

methods.name: getBasePixel
methods.description: Returns the pixel position of the minimal base value of the scale, used as a reference for drawing.

methods.name: getBaseValue
methods.description: Returns the value used as the base for the scale, typically zero or min/max depending on configuration.

methods.name: _autoSkip
methods.description: Determines and filters scale ticks to prevent label overlap, based on scale width and label size, accounting for rotation and max tick limit.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the entire scale on the chart canvas, including grid lines, tick marks, labels, and optional scale label, handling positioning and styling.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Iterates over an array or object, calling a provided function on each element or property, with optional context and reverse order.

methods.name: arrayEquals
methods.description: Deep comparison of two arrays to determine if they contain the same content.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an object or array, copying nested objects and arrays.

methods.name: _merger
methods.description: Default merger function used internally for merging object properties, recursively merging nested objects.

methods.name: _mergerIf
methods.description: Merge source properties into target only if target property is undefined.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Deeply merges multiple source objects or arrays into the target object, using a specified merger.

methods.name: mergeIf
methods.description: Alias for merge with default merger, merges only into undefined properties.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends the target object with properties from additional objects or arrays.

methods.name: inherits
methods.description: Sets up classical inheritance for constructor functions, enabling object extension.

methods.name: determineDataLimits
methods.description: Calculates the min and max data values for the scale based on datasets and options.

methods.name: handleTickRangeOptions
methods.description: Adjusts min and max values based on user options like beginAtZero, min, max.

methods.name: buildTicks
methods.description: Generates the tick marks based on the data range and scale options.

methods.name: convertTicksToLabels
methods.description: Converts numeric or timestamp ticks into formatted label strings for display.

methods.name: getPixelForValue
methods.description: Transforms a data value into a pixel position along the axis.

methods.name: getValueForPixel
methods.description: Returns the data value corresponding to a specific pixel position.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: A helper function to hide elements that have the WOW.js animation, setting their visibility to hidden and managing animation states.

methods.name: mdbWow
methods.description: Initializes WOW.js animations, hiding elements and setting up scroll event handlers to trigger animations when elements enter the viewport.

methods.name: updateTextFields
methods.description: Updates label and icon classes based on the value or placeholder presence in text inputs and textareas for visual effects.

methods.name: validateField
methods.description: Validates form fields with the 'validate' class, toggling validation classes based on input validity.

methods.name: textAreaAutoResize
methods.description: Automatically resizes textareas based on content to improve user experience.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes auto-resizing for textareas, attaching event listeners for dynamic height adjustment.
